title: Labor Code, Division 2, Part 4, Chapter 1 (Wages, Hours and Working Conditions)
verified_how: The LAB Div 2 expanded branch shows 'PART 4. EMPLOYEES 1171-1413', 'CHAPTER 1. Wages, Hours and Working Conditions 1171-1207'. I did not fetch §1182.12 individually.
notes: The state minimum wage is §1182.12. Detailed rates are also set by IWC wage orders, which are regulations.
